notes.title: Announcement of Multi Language Subtitle Package Update for Director Simulator
notes.notes:
Dear players：
In order to bring more high-quality game experience to the majority of players, it is convenient to play outside Chinese Mainland
We have updated the subtitle package of the game for players to enjoy the game better.
This update has added subtitles for multiple languages including traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, and more.
Our team is committed to providing a richer and more convenient gaming environment for players around the world, enabling us to
Home allows for a smoother immersion in the exciting world of gaming.
The updated subtitles will be more accurate and clear, helping you better understand the game plot
Gameplay instructions and various prompt information.
We sincerely thank every player for their support and love of our game. In the future, we will
Continue to work hard, constantly improve and optimize the game, bringing you more surprises and excitement!
                                                                                              Director Simulator Development Team
                                                                                                                August 8th, 2024
